title: The Harlem Globetrotters
seo_title: Harlem Globetrotters Rivalry Tour in Springfield, MO
description: The Harlem Globetrotters bring their Rivalry Tour basketball show to the court, facing the Washington Generals and a new lineup of rivals, with fan participation on the court and the jumbotron. It is for all ages, and a free pre-game tip-off party starts when doors open at 6:00 PM. The event is Tuesday, March 16, 2027 at 7:00 PM at Great Southern Bank Arena in Springfield, MO.
